name: LymFlow
headline: LymFlow
description: A complex of plant extracts to improve lymphatic drainage and vascular blood flow and to support the elasticity and strength of vessels. It contains extracts of cherry stalks, blackcurrant leaf, parsley and Chinese hibiscus.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule three times a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
